title: RES
describe: RES (resistance) is the foundation for rapid progression in Era of Revival. Boost your RES to face increasingly powerful Monsters.

title: Specialty Skill
describe: Upgrade Specialty Level to earn Skill Points, then spend them to Unlock powerful Specialty Skills.

title: RES Level
describe: Spend RES EXP to increase RES Level. Higher RES Level grants greater resistance stats and stronger advantages in Monster combat.

title: RES EXP
describe: Boost Lord's Specialty levels and slay Monsters to earn abundant RES EXP.

title: Specialty Choice
describe: Lords may choose between Handyman or Legion Commander Specialties. Handyman favors internal governance, while Legion Commander excels in combat conquest.

title: Lord's Specialty
describe: Select the ideal Lord's Specialty, master unique Specialty Skills, and secure powerful support for City development and battle.

title: Specialty Level
describe: Spend Specialty EXP to increase Specialty Level.

title: Specialty EXP
describe: Earn Specialty EXP by slaying Sandbox Monsters, opening Alliance Duel Chests, and claiming Kingdom War kill rewards.
